meaning.en: A person who sets type. Formerly an employee in a printshop who manually selected pieces of moveable type and assembled them for printing.

meaning.en: A person who sets type; compositor.

sentences.en: Set up time is the time it takes for a printer to "burn" a metal plate from typeset originals provided by a customer or in-house typesetter, and adjust his press so that the paper accurately feeds through press rollers.
